raw_text: The PM deepfake audio is a watershed moment for AI-enabled election interference in India. Voice cloning technology has reached the point where casual listeners can't distinguish real from fake. The spectral artifacts at 8-12kHz are the only reliable detection marker currently. We need real-time audio authentication tools deployed before every election going forward.
